sloka: प्रहस्य च महानादमुक्तो ऽहं भीमया तया ।अवस्थितमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वाक्यमशोभनम् ।। ५.५८.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: prahasya ca mahānādamukto 'haṁ bhīmayā tayā ।avasthitamasambhrāntamidaṁ vākyamaśobhanam ।। 5.58.38 ।।।।

translations.english: "She was frightening and laughed in loud voice without any hesitation. Steadfast she uttered these ominous words to me:
